title: BEYOND
focus_line: Hope is the confident expectation in God's promises, anchored in Christ.

verse.text: There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

session.prompt: Read Proverbs 23:15–18 and sit with the promise of a future that will not be cut off.

verses: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad indeed;
my inmost being will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.
Do not let your heart envy sinners, but always be zealous for the fear of the Lord.
There is surely a future hope for you, and your hope will not be cut off.

session.prompt: As the year ends, what hope are you carrying into the new one?

coaching_notes: The final four days of the year are for you to reflect. Don't rush these sessions. Be present and be patient.
